active_incumbents.description: Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants.
Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.

Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
Agent OS is a system for injecting your codebase standards and writing better specs for spec-driven development.

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides structured spec-driven development workflow tools for AI-assisted software development, featuring a real-time web dashboard and VSCode extension for monitoring and managing your project's progress directly in your development environment.
Turn complex codebases into clear, navigable architecture diagrams with Claude Code.
A text diagram language where you say where things go. Playground: reladraw.github.io/reladraw

Free, open-source diagram canvas. Draw it, write it as code (Mermaid, D2, Structurizr in), ask any AI model or a local one, let Claude Code edit it live over MCP, or map a GitHub repo with every arrow cited to a file and line. MIT, local-first, no account.

A Markdown Editor That Lives in Your Browser, Desktop, and a Single URL. Fast GitHub-style Markdown editing with live preview, diagrams, LaTeX, syntax highlighting, PDF export, and multi-tab support across web, desktop, and Docker.
A Claude Code skill that generates interactive HTML walkthroughs with clickable Mermaid diagrams to explain codebase features, flows, and architecture.
A Claude Code skill for OOP architecture planning and tracking — live Mermaid UML diagrams in CLAUDE.md that update as you code.

Interactive Claude Code skill for C4 architecture diagrams (Simon Brown's model) — mode-driven workflow with Mermaid / Structurizr / PlantUML output and filesystem or MCP (Notion / Linear / Drive) destinations.

A powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system that enables agents to work for long periods of time autonomously without losing track of the big picture

Automated workflows for Claude Code. Features spec-driven development for new features (Requirements → Design → Tasks → Implementation) and streamlined bug fix workflow for quick issue resolution (Report → Analyze → Fix → Verify).
